title: Personalized Basketball Hoop Comforter with Name and Number
description:
Bring the excitement of the court into your bedroom with this custom sports bedding by Jeminise. This personalized basketball comforter is designed for players and fans alike, offering a cozy and stylish way to showcase your passion for the game. Tailored with your choice of name and number, it makes a thoughtful and unique gift for birthdays, holidays, or any special occasion.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own name and number for a truly unique and personal touch.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • All-Season Comfort: Lightweight yet durable construction provides the perfect amount of warmth for year-round use.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on low or no heat to maintain fluffiness.
  • Versatile Options: Available in multiple bedding set sizes with options to add matching pillowcases or a flat sheet.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Basketball
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
